title.value: Towards Hybrid-grained Feature Interaction Selection for Deep Sparse Network
title.justification: The title is clearly stated in the document abstract.
title.quote: Towards Hybrid-grained Feature Interaction Selection for Deep Sparse Network

extractions.description: The paper introduces a hybrid-grained feature interaction selection approach for Deep Sparse Networks (DSNs). It proposes a method called OptFeature that selects feature interactions at both the feature field and value levels to enhance the prediction accuracy and efficiency of DSNs. Experiments on benchmark datasets show the superiority of this method in terms of accuracy and efficiency. The paper also addresses challenges like selection granularity and search space complexity.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The abstract and content focus primarily on technical advancements in neural network architectures and feature interaction selection for improved prediction tasks. There is no direct mention or application relating to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Deep Sparse Networks (DSNs) are commonly utilized neural network architectures for prediction tasks, designed to handle sparse and high-dimensional categorical features as inputs. These networks find widespread application in real-world scenarios such as advertisement recommendation, fraud detection, and more.
